narr: An isolated instance of flash flooding occurred due to heavy rain associated with showers and thunderstorms.
ev: Several roads were blocked by a few feet of standing water, including Stanton Road Southeast and Suitland Parkway, 11th Street Northeast and K Street Northeast. C Street Southeast and Kentucky Avenue Southeast were also blocked by high water.
